chapter.verse: Vanglianpen Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “En un, mi kiphasak khempeuh leh migilo khempeuh, a zung a hiang cih om loin buhtu bangin a kattum ding hun hong tung ding hi. Tua ni ciangin khat zong suakta loin a vekpi-in kangtum khin ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin ka thu a hong mang note tungah dikna ni hong taang ding a, tua in nizang bangin note tungah cidamna hong tun’ ding hi. Bawngkhumna panin a kikhah bawngnote bangin suakta-in nuam na sa ding uh hi.
Keimah in na kong sep ni ciangin, migilote nuaisiahin, leivui bangin na tuancil ding uh hi,” ci hi.
“Israel mite khempeuh in a zuih dingin Horeb Mual panin ka nasem Moses tungah ka piak ahi, Moses’ thukhamte, ngeinate, leh biakna ngeina kipte khempeuh lim takin phawk un.
“Ahi zongin tua a lauhuai a lian mahmah Topa ’ ni hong tun’ ma-in note kiangah kamsangpa Elijah kong paisak ding hi.
Amah in pate leh tapate, tapate leh pate lemtuahin kilemsak kik ding hi. Tua bang hi kei leh keimah hong pai-in na gam khempeuh uh ka susiagawp ding hi,”ci hi, a ci hi.
